summary: Spec fidelity (checker.md section 4/5: the contract's own example allowedEffects ['.canon/audit/access.jsonl']; snapshots list 'path, size, SHA-256 of every file'): the snapshot also lists directories (snapshot.rs Entry::Dir), so a read that creates .canon/audit and appends to access.jsonl changes two paths and a pattern that names the file allows only one. Real run: canon fixture copy with commands.query.allowedEffects ['.canon/audit/access.jsonl'], atip check --level L1: 'L2.effects fail SHOULD query: a successful read changed ./.canon/audit (outside its allowedEffects)'. The author must also list '.canon/audit' or use '.canon/**', which the contract does not say. The fake's peek writes '.peek-access.log' in the working directory, so no test creates a directory. Blast radius: every read command that creates the directory of its allowed file (the first read in a fresh state, the case the fixture always is); an L2 MUST. Fix options: an ancestor directory of an allowed file that did not exist before is not a change, or compare files only as checker.md says.
